entries.title: Prohibition of Harmful Cultural Practices
entries.content: Any person who performs, participates in, or encourages any harmful cultural, traditional or religious practice that negatively affects the health, dignity or social status of a woman or girl commits an offence and is liable to imprisonment.
entries.source: Gender Equality Act 2013, Laws of Malawi

entries.title: Sexual Harassment
entries.content: Sexual harassment in any workplace, educational institution, or public sphere is strictly prohibited. Sexual harassment includes unwelcome sexual advances, requests for sexual favours, or other verbal or physical conduct of a sexual nature.
entries.source: Gender Equality Act 2013, Laws of Malawi
